text.p: Secondhand tonnage brokers reported the sale of the following vessels in January.
K Prime - (built 1981) 136,211 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $11.5 million including twelve to eighteen months timecharter for $10,500 daily.
Ikan Beliak - (built 1980)64,957 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $9 million.
Premnitz - (built 1981) 38,250 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $4.3 million.
World Agamemnon - (built 1976) 37,451 dwt sold to undisclosed buyers for $3.2 million.
Bona Liv - 152,412 dwt sold to Swiss buyers for $35 million.
Hitra - (built 1984) 94,236 dwt sold to Malaysian buyers for $22.3 million.
Pernas Duyong - (built 1982) 82,253 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $15.4 million.
Kimberley - (built 1973) 25,300 dwt sold to undisclosed buyers for $1.55 million.
Zerva - (built 1981) sold to Egyptian buyers for $2.6 million.
Some of these sales may not be final as they may be subject to survey, inspection or other conditions.
